services.name: Our Cruises
services.desc: The iconic River Lady, sailing down the scenic Toms River, and beautiful Barnegat Bay, is a distinctive event venue. She is the only genuine paddle-wheel boat in the entire state, and has been the site of family celebrations, friends getting together, marriage proposals, surprise parties, and corporate events since 1989. Passengers range anywhere from couples to groups of 100 or more. Some reserve a few tables, others book an entire deck, or the whole boat. The Victorian (main) level, is enclosed and climate controlled, while the upper deck is open, but covered. The River Lady passes lovely waterfront homes, magnificent properties, docks, yacht clubs, historic areas, and often sailboat

blurb: The River Lady is a 150 passenger, 85′ authentic reproduction of a paddle wheel riverboat sailing down the scenic Toms River and Barnegat Bay. Public cruises run each week during the summer with sightseeing, lunch, and dinner options. The boat features enclosed climate-controlled main level and an open covered upper deck, with cabaret style seating mostly for 6 to 8 people per table.
